central_claim: Computational screening identifies threshold-sensitive full-gap parent pairing in NR4A3 junction gapmers and supports reproducible prioritization without establishing disease-specific excess or experimental selectivity.

optional_edits.evidence: The source calls this a Wilson95 interval over 190 registers; these comprise five overlapping registers per junction, only 176 distinct sequences, and are an enumerated design panel rather than an independent random disease sample.
optional_edits.consequence: The interval is a binomial reference calculation, not established disease-population uncertainty. The current conclusion of unresolved disease-specific excess remains appropriately cautious.
optional_edits.smallest_repair: Identify the interval explicitly as an independence-assuming Wilson reference interval and avoid treating overlap with it as a formal test of disease-specific excess.
